items.title: Tencent opens Hy4 flagship weights: 770B total, 49B active MoE, 1M context, natively multimodal, with FP8, Base and GGUF builds
items.summary: Weights, GitHub repo, community GGUF quants, a custom Hy License and a safety system card are all out; it follows the smaller Hy4-Flash. It is a multi-node download rather than a single-box one, and the license requires a separate agreement for hosted APIs above 50M USD revenue or 100M monthly users.

doubt.pushback: Repliers point out the license differs from the Apache 2.0 preview, with a revenue/MAU threshold for hosting, and that the 770B count covers the language backbone only, with vision encoder and a 3.3B drafter outside it.

reception.summary: Mostly thanks and quant or tool-support questions, with a few repliers flagging the license change and parameter-count scope; one claims it runs on a single Spark but gives no numbers.

items.title: Apple releases Depth Pro 2 on Hugging Face: metric monocular depth that stays consistent across video frames
items.summary: A new Hugging Face model card for sharp, temporally consistent metric depth from a single camera, with a short demo clip; the post gives no benchmark numbers.

items.title: Omarchy's next update installs Fantasi, a local image, short video clip and song maker with no cloud
items.summary: Fantasi is MIT-licensed and installed by default in the next Omarchy release: text-to-image, instruction edits, image-to-clip with sound (2, 5 or 10 s, memory permitting) and lyrics-to-song, all on local models. The post shows a 33 s demo; no model names or speeds are given.

items.title: Two DGX Sparks on one cable: listing both NCCL_IB_HCA devices lifts long-prompt processing 26-28%
items.summary: Each Spark port shows up as two network devices and using one gets about 112 of 200 Gb/s; naming both in NCCL_IB_HCA speeds prompt processing 26-28% with generation unchanged. The fix is merged into TensorFold's docs via the linked pull request.

items.title: Strata v0.2.17 fixes Coder, tool-call, Arc, AMD, swap and two-GPU long-context bugs in its own inference engine
items.summary: A stability release: app and Terminal 0.2.17 with engines 0.1.63 on every platform, following the move to Strata's own engine in 0.2.16.
